subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a typed reset-greeting policy/model override for bare `/new` and `/reset`, and what default should it use across chat and Gateway reset surfaces?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug fix: the default affects users who want no token spend and users who depend on persona/startup greeting behavior, while adding model routing touches compatibility-sensitive config and provider-selection surfaces.

options.title: Unified policy, no-model default
options.body: Keep today’s static acknowledgement as the default, but add an explicit typed policy for startup/model greeting and optional cheaper reset-greeting model routing.

options.title: Restore greeting by default
options.body: Make bare resets run the model again by default, with an explicit suppress/static-ack option for users optimizing token spend.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and leave reset prompt/model selection unconfigurable until maintainers close the broader reset-contract discussion.

recommendation.title: Unified policy, no-model default
recommendation.body: Keep today’s static acknowledgement as the default, but add an explicit typed policy for startup/model greeting and optional cheaper reset-greeting model routing.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest routing owner from recent reset acknowledgement commits and the prior review comment that framed this as a product decision.
